system_prompt: You are helping the user with questions about the people in their life. If a people-context MCP server is available, resolve the person first and read their stored context before answering; never guess an identity you could look up. Answer concisely, state only what you actually know, and say plainly when you do not know something.

tasks.title: Tell apart two contacts who share a first name
tasks.prompt: Two of my contacts are both called Priya. Which one works at Kestrel Analytics, and what is her role there? Give her full name and her role.

rubric.description: Names Priya Raman as a whole name, not the similarly named Priya Ramanathan.
States both the organisation and the role held there.
Does not attribute the other Priya's organisation or role to the answer.

tasks.title: Recall a contact's organisation, role, and update preference
tasks.prompt: What do you know about Tomas Brandt: where does he work, what is his role, and how does he prefer to receive updates? Answer in one short paragraph.

rubric.description: Names the organisation Tomas Brandt is affiliated with.
Names the role he holds there.
Reports the stored update preference rather than a generic one.
Does not place him at another contact's organisation.

tasks.title: Draft a message that follows both sides' stated preferences
tasks.prompt: Draft a short message to Tomas Brandt asking him to confirm a date for the September operations review. Follow my own communication philosophy and his stated update preference. Reply with the message text only.

rubric.description: Names the meeting and the month it concerns.
Honours the user's stated philosophy by opening without filler pleasantries.
values: I hope this email finds you well
I hope this message finds you well
I hope you are doing well

rubric.description: Formats the message as bullet points, which is the recipient's stored preference.
Asks for a specific confirmation rather than open-ended availability.

tasks.title: Explain how the user is connected to a contact
tasks.prompt: How am I connected to Priya Raman? Name the people on the shortest path between us, in order.

rubric.description: Names both people on the shortest path.
Presents the hops in route order rather than as an unordered set of names.
Ends at Priya Raman rather than the similarly named contact.
Does not place the other Priya's organisation on the path.

tasks.title: Identify the most overdue contact and the last interaction date
tasks.prompt: As of 1 August 2026, which contact have I gone longest without any interaction? Name that one person and the date we last spoke.

rubric.description: Names Ingrid Solberg, whose last interaction is the oldest on record.
States 5 March 2026 in any common written form.
Does not present the most recently seen contact as the overdue one.
